propositions: rebar must support s3:// URLs as sync.remote values for ticket-store, with ticket data encrypted at rest in customer-owned SSE-KMS buckets and never stored in GitHub

when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below pinned minimum version, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install command

concurrent or legacy S3 pushes can create multiple <sha>.bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at multiple SHAs and new clones to hard-fail; this multi-bundle state must self-heal non-interactively by merging divergent heads, with all commits reachable and no data discarded

operators must be able to enable and configure the S3 backend from documentation alone, including optional dependency declaration, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket and IAM setup, and sync.remote configuration
